pivot: Anchor at ring center, horizontal world plane

runtime_inputs.companionID: Stable game-owned identifier for the separated goose. Optional placement suggestions may use the companion’s horizontal heading.
runtime_inputs.rescueAnchorWorld: World point selected by the game in reachable space near companionID. Project into current fixed camera to steer any separate offscreen indicator.
runtime_inputs.escortProgress: Clamped 0–1 progress from game; remap with smoothstep to drive scale = 1 - .58s and whole-cue opacity = 1 - s.
runtime_inputs.state: Separated: fade in over .33 s; escorting: converge and fade with progress; rejoined/invalid/unsafe anchor: disable the entity.
runtime_inputs.safeAnchor: Host validates world placement against game Zone and traversability before enabling the cue.
runtime_inputs.cameraFacing: Ring remains horizontal; rotate only the point about world up to face camera.
